project: TechAvenue Computer & Accessories Store Management System

frames.name: Admin - Dashboard (Overview)
components: Fixed Sidebar (240px)
Header Bar with Toggle Button & Greeting
Compact Toolbar (Greeting + Sync Data + Export CSV)
Underline Tab Bar (All Overview / Sales / Inventory / AI / Activity)
4 KPI StatCards (Daily Sales, Monthly Revenue, Total Products, Low-Stock Alerts)
Daily & Monthly Sales Trend vs Projected Line Chart
Inventory Status Distribution Donut Chart
Recent Sales Transactions Empty State Card
Low-Stock Alert Products Table with + Restock shortcut

frames.name: Admin - Master Inventory Catalog
components: Catalog Header & Add New Product CTA
Search Bar with Clear (X) Button
Category Dropdown Filter
Results Counter ('Showing 11 items')
Inventory Table with 9 Columns (SKU, Image + Name, Brand, Cost, Retail, Margin % Cyan Pill, Stock, Status, Edit/Delete Action Buttons)

frames.name: Sales Personnel - POS Terminal
components: Barcode / SKU Scanner Search Bar
Product Grid Cards (3-column responsive)
Sticky Right Order Cart Panel (35% width)
Itemized Cart Rows with Steppers (+/-)
Subtotal, VAT (12%), Grand Total calculation in PHP (₱)
Payment Method Toggle (Cash, GCash, Maya, Card)
Complete Sale & Print Receipt Primary CTA

frames.name: Modals & Profile Overlay
components: Edit Product Modal with Cost, Retail, Margin calculation, and Delete Product button
Layout 3 Profile Card Popup with Cyan gradient banner, 54px overlapping avatar, Dark Mode switch, Fullscreen toggle, Text scaling stepper, and Sign Out button
Top-Right Floating Toast Notification (Green Success / Red Error)

prototypeFlows.action: Open overlay (Manual position directly under avatar)
